title: Epidemiological R0 for Shared-Blind-Spot Propagation Across an LLM Pipeline

original_idea.body:
# Epidemiological R0 for Shared-Blind-Spot Propagation

Simulate a small relay pipeline of open models passing content; inject seeded errors and measure an empirical error reproduction number, then test whether mixing in a behaviorally different model drops R below 1. Relay inference; no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — contagion metric for cascading failures with an explicit heterogeneity mitigation, tied to a flagged open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: build a small relay pipeline, inject errors, compute R-effective; harness adds moderate complexity, guided feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (R, R<1 test) with the relay harness as a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: open models + simulated pipeline, no internal access, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Relay inference across open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Epidemiological R0 applied to LLM error propagation appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known epidemiological R0 framing for LLM pipeline error propagation.
